ostrzezenia.tekst: Pumpkin is naturally a low-acid food for canning, with a pH above 4.6.
Home canning is not recommended for mashed or puréed pumpkin or winter squash.

akapity: According to an FDA table of approximate values, pumpkin has a pH of 4.8–5.2.
Almost any food that is not very acidic, with a pH above 4.6, can support the growth of Clostridium botulinum and toxin production.
The USDA has no tested recipes for safely canning certain pumpkin preserves and storing them at room temperature.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for pumpkin jam from a checked source.
